data: the 417 exploration questions of exp20, eight models (the runs with wording_set no_question)

scores.verdict: final-layer log-odds of the affirmative against the negative reply token, question shown
scores.question_free: the same log-odds for the same wording with the question removed from the user message
scores.corrected: verdict minus question_free, weight 1, nothing tuned (the tested method)
scores.sum: verdict plus question_free (reported, not part of the decision)

test: MC1 of corrected minus MC1 of verdict on the same questions: 95% paired-bootstrap interval (10000 resamples, seed 0 per model and wording) and exact McNemar
a_model_shows_the_gain_if: the difference is positive and the interval excludes 0
a_model_shows_a_loss_if: the difference is negative and the interval excludes 0
models_counted: those whose verdict is above chance at the final layer (MC1 at least the chance level plus two standard errors); the others are reported and not counted
decision: prior-corrected self-evaluation is a method candidate only if at least 5 of the counted models show the gain with the primary wording and none shows a loss. A candidate still needs the confirmation questions and a second dataset. Otherwise the result is reported as the control only.
